_comment: Film 25 slot metadata (format as films/24-animals/audio/clips.json). 'dur' (seconds of real footage) is set when a K clip is cut; until then build_vo.py uses the planned slot length (data root clips.json 'dauer' for K1/K2). 'offset': footage starts this long after the slot opens. 'cues': [[seconds from first footage frame, subtitle line]]. cue_status: 'whisper' = checked wording, 'provisional' = wording from o-ton/auswahl-v1.md + pocketsphinx, verify; 'estimated' = times spread over the planned length, re-time on the real footage.
